proposal.reason: Main change is removing CollNet execution paths from PCCL’s transport/connect layer (transport/coll_net removal, transport wiring, and connect flows). Additional modules are needed because the PR also independently removes CollNet plugin loading/runtime network hooks (network), deletes CollNet device kernel implementations while reserving null function-table slots (kernels), changes built-in algorithm/protocol cost and availability logic to keep CollNet ID reserved but unselectable (tuning), removes CollNet logical graph construction/connection APIs (graph-search), drops CollNet-related topology detection fields/NIC discovery behavior (device-topology), and updates runtime planning/selection and tuner fallback behavior in collective enqueue logic (enqueue).
